title: ContextEnvelope Contract
description: S3: the declared context envelope of a governed run. The run's context content (objective plus bounded payload) and the declared executor token usage must fit the envelope budget; the runner enforces both fail-closed (SPEC_CONTEXT_BUDGET_EXCEEDED) and emits the observability spine's declared resource.budget_check event. The work unit's context_envelope_ref points at this declared envelope — it is no longer a nominal, never-resolved string. Minimal by design: no deferred budget-engine semantics, no runtime metering (the resource-governor stays a declaration).
